testProvenance.ordinaryFlows: Stable public pilot observes detached JSON public snapshots with underscore fields removed every five60Hz ticks. Original create/step receives keyboard-equivalent inputs: multi-stone trial, exact B restoration without move/time refund, then both-condition success. These are model simulations; elapsed30.933/36.517/40.433s is not a browser-video duration. No author route or private solver is read.
testProvenance.ordinaryNegatives: Public bounded planner selects two separate goals on each map; actual navigation/A inputs reach order-only and holes-only states, which remain playing. Three move-limit failures use actual nonwinning compactions. Timeout uses5400 ordinary neutral ticks. One preview selects an actual pillar-split line.
testProvenance.publicValueFixture: Only one public stone value is changed on a fresh state, then one real model tick recomputes public facts. S1 and S2 both show1 but remain separate physical IDs; strict order fails. This is explicitly synthetic, not an authored board, normal play or a successful browser run.
testProvenance.runtimeLayouts: Two genuine original source-runtime sequences use real Enter, Space and P events for menu/play/first compaction/pause. Sixteen snapshots explicitly replace scratch-served create with a public-state copy and step with no-op:14 ordinary-derived layouts and2 views of the value fixture. They are not restored simulations or browser-earned outcomes.
testProvenance.readOnly: Render receives deeply frozen state; throwing getters guard underscore/private/hidden fields and any PureModel API read. Different external time/raw-input arguments preserve drawing commands, HUD and result. Stone identity, values, interpolation within the original pillar-separated segment, snake reading and all16 action coordinates are measured against public state.
testProvenance.GPU: Chromium SwiftShader WebGL1 actual drawElements instrumentation:1 draw,1 texture, GL0 in every case;1024 atlas. Context loss/restoration reproduces pixels. No physical GPU or TV hardware claim.
testProvenance.history: Preliminary7c5 source,12/2/6 report and original harness copies remain immutable in art-preliminary. Root requested one copy-only NEXT clarification. This final run fully regenerates all35/2/16 on finalfe53; no old source evidence is relabelled. Model/formal/pilot/math tests were not repeated for that wording change.

wordingConclusions: NEXT labels the following selected compaction, including a free no-op after the previous charged move.
Order and exact-hole predicates remain independent; neither ordinary single-condition counterexample is called accepted.
Actual move/undo trails use only public transition records; terminal states render committed positions with no stale action preview.
Undo restoration retains moves spent; no-op is free without adding history.
Win, move-limit loss and90s timeout have short cause-specific result text; measured at both viewport sizes.

previewCopyRevision.scope: Preliminary source retained unchanged. One approved preview-label clarification before final source art; no model, pilot, rules or geometry changed.

findings: Smooth carved sandstone, fixed green-gray pillars and warm sand relief are visually distinct. Large actual values and smaller physical IDs remain readable with eight stones at960.
All16 arrow buttons remain visible; blue alternating snake guide and the complete unsorted actual-reading row agree with the board.
NEXT distinguishes next-action cost from the charged movement currently interpolating. Undo restores original IDs and cells while the move counter remains spent.
Order-only and hole-only ordinary states remain active with one passing check and one failing check. Equal-value fixture retains both IDs and uses the non-increasing marker.
Compact/undo motion stays inside public pillar-separated segments. Terminal boards are settled and captions/results accurately distinguish win, budget exhaustion and timeout.
The full sidebar, short help, tip, blurred dialogs and single-line result text fit the measured960/1280 layouts. No unresolved visual finding.
The512px icon uses original self-contained relief stones and a snake-like reading path; it discloses no authored solution.
